The '''BramDorc Corporation''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer based in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that specialized in massive vessels. BramDorc disappeared from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] record around [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]], and by [[44 ABY]] only three BramDorc products were known to exist; the [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]] ''[[Rockhound]]'', a waterhunter known as the ''[[Icebreaker]]'' and the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] tanker ''[[Gasbag]]''.
